prompt: High aerial at night over a vast British motorway interchange of stacked concrete flyovers, every lane jammed: a line of fire runs along one curving flyover like a lit fuse, an overturned fuel tanker burning at the barrier, black smoke drifting over the town beyond where the streetlights are going out district by district. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
